EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_IMPORT_RECOVERY.TITLE: Let’s fix your recipient list
EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_IMPORT_RECOVERY.PRESERVED: Your campaign and email draft are saved. No recipients from this failed attempt were added.

EMAIL.REASON: We could not find a recipient email column.
EMAIL.CORRECTION: Include a column containing recipient email addresses. You can name it Email; a person’s name is optional.

AMBIGUOUS.REASON: We could not identify the intended recipient column with enough confidence.
AMBIGUOUS.CORRECTION: If there are multiple address columns, mark the intended one as Primary recipient email or keep only that address column. Check the column labels and upload the file again.

NAME.REASON: Multiple columns could represent the contact’s name.
NAME.CORRECTION: Distinguish Contact name from Company name, then upload the corrected file.

FILE.REASON: The file could not be read as a supported spreadsheet.
FILE.CORRECTION: Save it as CSV or XLSX, check that it opens correctly, then upload it here.

WIDTH.REASON: This spreadsheet has too many columns to analyse.
WIDTH.CORRECTION: Keep up to 254 columns, including the recipient email column, then upload it again.

SIZE.REASON: The file exceeds the upload size limit.
SIZE.CORRECTION: Split the list into smaller files and upload one here.

EMPTY.REASON: No recipient rows were found in this file.
EMPTY.CORRECTION: Include a header row and recipient rows below it, then upload the file again.

ROWS.CORRECTION: Split the list into files with up to 50,000 rows each.

EXPIRED.REASON: The original uploaded file has expired.
EXPIRED.CORRECTION: Choose the file again and upload it here.

UPLOAD.REASON: The uploaded file could not be stored.
UPLOAD.CORRECTION: Choose your file again and retry the upload here.

CONFIG.REASON: The list analysis service is not configured or its access key was rejected.
CONFIG.CORRECTION: Ask your administrator to review the TypeSafe configuration. Keep this draft and upload the file after access is restored.

SERVICE.REASON: The list analysis service could not complete this attempt.
SERVICE.CORRECTION: Retry the original file. If this continues, ask your administrator to review the service; changing the spreadsheet may not help.

UNKNOWN.REASON: The import could not be completed. No more specific cause is available for this attempt.
UNKNOWN.CORRECTION: Retry the original file or upload a corrected CSV or XLSX here. If it fails again, contact your administrator.

ADDRESSES.REASON: This file has no valid recipient email addresses.
ADDRESSES.CORRECTION: Check that this is the intended email column and correct the addresses. For example: person{'@'}example.com. Then upload the file here.

REQUEST.REASON: The list analysis service rejected this request.
REQUEST.CORRECTION: Ask your administrator to review the analysis service. Repeating the same request will not resolve this error; your draft is saved.
